character: The world's largest connected ski area — 600 km marketed, ~508 km independently measured. 8 resorts, 3 valleys, 2,823 snow cannons, 284,500 skiers per hour.
description: The world's largest linked ski area — 600km of pistes, 183 lifts, 8 resorts across the Belleville, Courchevel, and Méribel valleys. Stretches from 1,300m (Brides) to 3,230m (Pointe du Bouchetin at Val Thorens). Includes Val Thorens (Europe's highest resort at 2,300m), Courchevel (glamour and Michelin dining), Méribel (family-friendly mid-valley), Les Menuires (value), Saint-Martin (authentic), Brides (thermal spa), La Tania (convenient), and Orelle (linked by gondola). Known for: scale, snow guarantee (high altitude), luxury options, and variety for all levels. The 6th day of skiing is free — all 6-day passes priced as 5.

stats.operators: S3V, Méribel Alpina (Compagnie des Alpes), SEVABEL, SETAM/STOR

weather_snow.key_note: Val Thorens at 2,300 m is the snow-surest. Méribel mid-altitude (1,450 m) relies 50% on snowmaking. Courchevel and La Tania lower still. Orelle access from Maurienne side holds snow well at altitude.

resorts.name: Courchevel
resorts.character: Prestige, luxury, 4 altitude villages (1850/1650/1550/Le Praz), Michelin dining, designer shopping, Altiport

resorts.name: Méribel
resorts.character: Heart of 3V, chalet architecture, British favourite, Olympic Park sports complex, 4 villages (Centre/Mottaret/Village/Les Allues)

resorts.name: Val Thorens
resorts.note: Europe's highest resort at 2,300 m. 99% terrain above 2,000 m. 6 glaciers. Lively apres with La Folie Douce. Ski-in/ski-out throughout.

resorts.name: Les Menuires
resorts.character: Budget-friendly, functional architecture, good snow at 1,850 m

resorts.name: St-Martin-de-Belleville
resorts.character: Traditional Savoyard village, La Bouitte ★★ Michelin, Sunday market

resorts.name: Brides-les-Bains
resorts.character: Thermal spa town, 30-50% cheaper than altitude, Olympe gondola to Méribel in 20 min

resorts.name: La Tania
resorts.character: Compact family resort, built for 1992 Albertville Olympics, wooded setting

resorts.name: Orelle
resorts.character: Quiet Maurienne valley gateway, cheapest 3V access, Orelle gondola to Val Thorens sector at 3,200 m

dining_highlights_3v: 11 Michelin-starred restaurants across the domain. Baumanière 1850 ★★, Le Sarkara ★★, La Bouitte ★★, Le Farçon ★, L'Ekrin ★.
honest_drawbacks: Marketed at 600 km but independently measured at ~508 km — ~18% gap
Highest prices in the Alps — Courchevel 1850 among world's most expensive
Crowded during school holidays — February peak, significant lift queues
3 valleys require lift transfers, not always direct between sectors
Limited expert/off-piste vs Chamonix or Espace Killy
Brides-les-Bains at 600 m valley floor requires gondola to skiing
name: Les 3 Vallées

lift_pass_pricing.family_discount: Family Flex: all ski at child rate. Min 3 people (max 2 adults + 1 child aged 5-17). 6-day Family Flex: €301.50 early/late, €335 high season.
lift_pass_pricing.discount_info: Early season (6-19 Dec) adult 6-day €368. Late season (11-17 Apr) adult 6-day €368. Main season 20 Dec-10 Apr €409. 6th day free.
lift_pass_pricing.insurance: Carré Neige available at €3.50/day or €21/6 days.

suitability.beginners: Excellent — dedicated nursery slopes in every resort. Green runs at each village base. Val Thorens has extensive gentle blues. Courchevel 1850 has nursery slopes at 1,850m. Family Flex pass saves money.
suitability.intermediates: The world's best intermediate terrain — 40% blue, 32% red. The Cîmes gondola (Courchevel-Méribel link) opens up endless blue/red combinations. The 600km are largely blue/red cruising.
suitability.advanced: Excellent — black runs from each summit. Les Menuires rock face area, Courchevel Grand Couloir, Val Thorens Fontaine Froide. Steep off-piste in the Combe de la Saulire. The Sarenne (Alpe d'Huez extension) is Europe's longest black at 16km.
suitability.families: World-class for families. Dedicated kids' areas (Village des Enfants in Val Thorens, Méribel Olympic Park), ski schools with English instructors, Family Flex pass pricing. Toboggan runs, bowling, ice skating, and cinemas in every village.

signature_runs.name: Grand Couloir
signature_runs.description: Iconic Courchevel black from Saulire summit — steep, narrow, often mogulled

signature_runs.name: Cîmes du Vallon
